messages:
maya: :wave: quick roll-up — trying to get everyone aligned for the SDK/docs/quickstarts cutover. Changelog cutoff is EOD Thursday (UTC). Can owners confirm status and any blockers? Tentative owners: @samir (SDK), @pri (Docs), @jun (Sample apps). If you need the cutoff pushed, say why and propose a date.

samir: PR queue status: 3 open SDK PRs (two bugfixes, one perf tweak). I can merge the bugfixes today after a quick review. The perf PR needs extra perf-run. ETA tomorrow.

pri: Docs: I’ve got the new quickstart draft but missing the sample app screenshots and the new config table for retries. If @jun can push the sample app demo build with the updated env, I’ll finish the docs. Otherwise I’ll stub screenshots and follow up in a patch.

jun: Sample apps: hitting a flaky env var in the py sample on linux runners — reproduces locally with THIS env combo. I pushed a temporary fallback to master: 
```bash
export SAMPLE_API_KEY=devkey_local
pytest tests/test_integration.py::TestQuickstart -k docker
```
I’ll open a follow-up PR to remove fallback once infra fixes land.

aaron: Legal asked for two lines in the changelog about data handling changes — small copy tweak but needs sign-off. Not a blocker for build but we should include it before release. @pri can you add the language and ping legal?

ci-bot: Failing job: linux-ci-3 (integration) — error: ConnectionResetError in test_setup.py:42. Full log: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"tests/test_setup.py\", line 42, in setup_module\n    client.connect()\nConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer\n```
Flaky ~ 2/50. Marked unstable, retest advised.

maya: Thanks. Quick decisions:
- @samir merge bugfixes today; hold perf PR until perf run completes.
- @jun keep fallback but add a clear TODO and reference the issue number.
- @pri add legal copy to changelog and update quickstart screenshots once jun's demo build lands.
- If CI keeps failing, we do a manual cherry-pick for critical fixes and notify release-engineering.

samir: Ack. I’ll merge two bugfix PRs this afternoon and trigger the perf-run job. If perf fails, we can still release with a note and a follow-up perf patch.

pri: Will add legal text and push a changelog entry draft in ~2h. I’ll also stub screenshots now so docs don’t block the cutoff.

jun: Adding TODO + issue ref in the fallback PR now. Also kicking a rerun of linux-ci-3.

aaron: I’ll coordinate legal sign-off in parallel, should be quick. If anything stalls, I’ll escalate.

maya: Great — last ask: please add a one-line status update in this thread when you finish your item so I can close the release ticket. :thumbsup:
